sources.motorconst: measured once on one bench STS3215 servo (12 V)
sources.resistance: measured once on one bench STS3215 servo (12 V)
sources.kp: motorconst/resistance * supply * P * 0.166 (BAM's STS3215 error gain) * 1.10365 (measured on the same servo)
sources.kd: motorconst^2/resistance: cancels dcmotor's back-EMF compensation term (the STS3215 drives voltage)
sources.slewmax: stand-in for the firmware acceleration profile at Acceleration = Maximum_Acceleration = 254 (no native element limits setpoint acceleration); set on the same bench servo
sources.armature: measured once on one bench STS3215 servo (12 V)
sources.damping: measured once on one bench STS3215 servo (12 V)
sources.frictionloss: one constant for the load- and speed-dependent gearbox friction; set on the same bench servo
sources.not mapped: D (the model has no D term) and the load- and speed-dependent parts of the friction (folded into the frictionloss constant)
